status: Settings fixed before new model comparison results
purpose: Compare target-independent acoustic measurement, not pronunciation correctness or learning
data: Previously used Hillenbrand full recordings; bigdata.dat references at 20, 50, 80 percent of annotated vowel duration; zeros excluded and counted. Reference boundaries are oracle annotations, not automatic segmentation.
population: All recordings with matching annotation and audio. Adults reported separately from child stress cases. Entire corpus is exploratory because previous development used its midpoint clips.

heatmap.output: upstream bin convention; interpolated at reference time; full-utterance noncausal inference
heatmap.right_padding: 64 zero spectral frames, cropped after inference; deterministic equivalent of upstream batch padding. Selected using published example before corpus comparison.

multiceiling_selection: Minimum squared distance to neural estimate scaled by [120,220]; no target, reference, speaker sex or corpus label enters estimator. Average chosen Burg and neural estimates only when both differences satisfy thresholds.
large_error_definition: F1 absolute error >150 Hz OR F2 absolute error >300 Hz; engineering threshold, not pronunciation acceptability
stress_selection: First three ih and three iy IDs within each corpus group under salted SHA256 ordering; all copies stay linked to original speaker
streaming_probe: One frozen ih or iy recording per group; midpoint estimates using only prefix through reference time plus 0,100,250,450 ms; compare with full recording; explicit context and CPU time
independence: No fine tuning; no holdout or external validity claim. Paper includes both VTR-only and combined-corpus training including Hillenbrand; exact published checkpoint training split is unverified. Treat overlap as possible. Stress copies are not new speakers. Synthetic signals do not validate real learners.
reference_audit: bigdata.dat midpoint differs from prior vowdata.dat at four IDs: b02iy, b13er, g08iy, w49eh. Use bigdata consistently for every method and all three times; do not compare headline values directly with old midpoint-only benchmark.
